badge.sentForApproval: Sent for approval. It will go ahead once your approvers agree.
badge.heldNotice: This requirement is waiting for approval inside your company. It has not been sent to any supplier yet.

account.title: Team and approvals
account.body: Invite colleagues, set who can approve what, and review requests waiting for you.

team.title: Team
team.description: People who can act for {business}, and what each of them may do.
team.inviteSent: Invitation sent. The link works for 7 days.
team.rolesHelp: Owner and Admin manage the team and approval rules. Requesters post requirements and accept quotes. Approvers and Finance decide approvals. Viewers can only look.
team.transferNoMembers: Add another member first, then you can hand over ownership.
team.stepUpHint: We ask again because this cannot be undone by you.
team.stepUpMfa: Authenticator or recovery code (if you use one)
team.transferWarning: The new owner gets full control. You become an Admin.
team.transferred: Ownership transferred. You are now an Admin.

accept.title: Team invitation
accept.heading: Join {business}
accept.invalid: This invitation link is not valid. Ask your colleague to send a new one.
accept.expired: This invitation has expired. Ask your colleague to send a new one.
accept.body: You are invited as {role}. It was sent to {email}; you must be signed in with that address.
accept.done: You have joined the team. Open your account to continue.

rules.title: Approval rules
rules.description: Decide when a purchase needs someone else's approval. People cannot approve their own requests.
rules.empty: No rules yet. Everything goes ahead without approval, except when someone passes their monthly spend limit.
rules.readOnly: Only owners and admins can change rules.
rules.name: Rule name
rules.chainHint: Up to 3 steps. Each step needs a different person.
rules.levelPeopleHint: If you pick people, only they decide this step.
rules.levelMinHint: Use 0 to always include this step.

delegation.title: Out of office
delegation.description: Let a colleague approve for you while you are away. They still cannot approve their own requests.
delegation.onlyApprovers: Only people who can approve can delegate.

spend.title: Spend limits
spend.description: A monthly cap for each person. Going over it does not block a purchase; it sends it to an owner or admin for approval.
spend.note: Counted from quotes a person accepted, in the calendar month (India time).

inbox.title: Approvals
inbox.description: Requests that need a decision, and the ones you asked for.

waiting.title: Nothing is waiting for you
waiting.body: When a colleague needs your approval it appears here and you get a notification.

mine.title: You have not asked for any approval
mine.body: If a purchase needs approval under your company's rules, it will be listed here.

all.title: No approval requests yet
all.body: Requests from everyone on the team show up here.

detail.title: Approval request
detail.overLimit: This is above the requester's monthly spend limit, so an owner or admin must approve it.

decide.title: Your decision
decide.commentHint: Optional when approving. Required when rejecting, so the requester knows why.
decide.doneApproved: Approved. The request is going ahead.
decide.doneRejected: Rejected. The requester has been told.
decide.doneNext: Approved. It now goes to the next approver.
decide.waitingBody: You will be notified as soon as it is decided. You can withdraw it while it is waiting.

team.roleNotAllowed: Your role does not allow this.
team.onlyOwnerAdmin: Only the owner can grant, invite or remove the Admin role.
team.alreadyMember: That person is already on your team.
team.sizeLimit: Your team has reached its size limit.
team.tooManyInvites: Too many pending invitations. Revoke some first.
team.inviteExpired: This invitation has expired. Ask for a new one.
team.inviteWrongAccount: Sign in with the email address this invitation was sent to.
team.ownerRole: Transfer ownership instead of changing the owner's role.
team.ownRole: You cannot change your own role.
team.ownerRemove: The owner cannot be removed. Transfer ownership first.
team.onlyOwnerTransfer: Only the owner can transfer ownership.

approvals.alreadyDecided: This request has already been decided.
approvals.selfApproval: You cannot approve your own request.
approvals.differentApprover: A different person must approve each step.

approvals.delegateTooLong: Delegation can last at most 90 days.
approvals.quoteRejected: The approval for this quote was rejected.
